_comment: The install script (install.sh) writes paths.json in the install folder. Copy this file to
~/.config/sdrexplorer/paths.json for your own overrides. Leave out any key you don't need:
external builds default to <install>/ext/<name>, else the system's PATH / Python path.
Relative paths are relative to this file. Check the result with: python3 -m sdrexplorer.paths
Modules' own keys (gr_pager, op25, op25_apps, dsd_fme, ...) go here too: see each module's README.
